data.name: Kill Dee 2
data.detailed_description:
Kill Dee 2 is the sequel to the legendary game Kill Dee. This time it’s an ultra-exciting 2D linear platformer with a super engaging story.

Once again, the game features two storylines that intersect and interact with each other. In each storyline, you will play as a different main character and experience their journey as the stories gradually connect.

At first it might seem like the graphics and visual style couldn’t possibly improve any further — but no. The developer proves to be a genius, raising the standards for the gaming industry with the release of the second installment.
This sequel also added cut scenes like in visual novels.

John’s story branch has multiple endings. Boris’s storyline remains linear.

Playtime of this game could last from 2 to 7 hours. It depends on you because some levels could be difficult. 

  • First story tells the tale of John Walker. His wife was kidnapped by the “LoveHat Gang.” Now you’re not just searching for her anymore — you’re also destroying entire gangs along the way.

    You’ll need to talk to (interact with) NPCs to figure out what to do next on each level and get closer to your goal, choosing different dialogue options along the way.

  • Second story speaks of Boris. He has a similar trouble as John - his son was kidnapped by the same gang. Boris also continues his search for his son, once again fighting through crowds of gangsters and bandits along the way.

    Both main heroes have a close attack weapon, a long range weapon and their 'Ultimate' attack.

    Experience joy, sadness and inspiration in a world you will never forget.
    P.S If you have any question or troubles with the game - write to me on Steam -

data.short_description: Kill Dee 2 is a super interesting platformer with a very exciting story. It is a mix of parkour, fighting, visual novel. Has many differenct endings. The game changes the gameplay from level to level, but mainly it is a platform game. It contains 2 storylines.
